meta.expect: Moves one position at a time on evidence, ends at the rewrite to put this behind him; debrief Where she ended says fair outcome; What she never said names the laptop and how close the 11:31 PM times came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me.
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Then take the zero off today, and tell me what you have.
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.
I'm writing those times down. Owen drafts by hand and types it up later, and he's been up late for weeks. Who decided on the zero, and where was he heard first?
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.
Fine, I'll ask him for it. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, not in front of his class. And I want the zero's status in writing tonight.
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Which line? Students misquote Shakespeare from memory all the time.
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.

Forty minutes in a classroom against an essay he had time on isn't a comparison. Anyone writes differently under a clock. Put the version history and the line from the play on paper, with dates, and I'll read them.

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

Okay. A private rewrite, to put this behind him, and I want the email tonight saying the zero is withdrawn and nothing goes in his record. I also want a date for it, with the new mark in before December 1.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private, supervised rewrite under 4.4, whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing placed in Owen's record. I still want the zero withdrawn, a date for the rewrite, and the new mark entered before December 1. I expect all of it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, where she accepted a private supervised rewrite to put this behind him, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a date for the rewrite, the new mark in before December 1, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record; that is the fair outcome under 4.4, and her time never ran out.
What moved her: you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then showed version history with exact times she could check herself, which met her need for something specific and dated.
What cost ground: when she asked which line was not in the play, you did not name it, so that piece stayed unchecked and she brushed it aside.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night editing times came very close to that night, which is why she wrote them down and went straight to procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked which line, give her the line itself and the act so she can search it on the spot.
